tasks.instruction: MUSE-76: bounded diagnostics only. Read MUSE.md and your MUSE_TASKS entry. The lead candidate shader had no report after300s; we cannot tell compile, link or first draw. Add OPTIONAL synchronous onStage callback to createConnectedRenderer options, called before/after vertex compilation, fragment compilation, program link, and the FIRST draw submission/completion (include getError completion; once per renderer). Default absent hook must leave rendering unchanged. No shaders, math, uniforms, cache, timeout or lifecycle policy changes. In app/connected-global-preview.js check mode ONLY, provide callback sending short fixed stage names to a new /__stage endpoint of tools/page-check.js. Stages never finish the report promise. Keep at most16 validated stage records; limit request bodies, reject unknown names; include latest RECEIVED stage/time in timeout output and normal test evidence. Clearly call it last received stage, not proof where the GPU stalled; asynchronous delivery can lag. No stages or networking in ordinary non-check play. Factor pure validation/recording into tools/render-stage.js if useful. Add render-stage.test.js with invalid/oversize messages and evidence that a stage cannot become final report; use a GL mock for callback ordering/once behavior if feasible without mirroring internals. Allowed files only engine/geometry/connected-renderer.js, app/connected-global-preview.js, tools/page-check.js, tools/render-stage.js, render-stage.test.js, docs/qa/muse76-render-stages.md. Run focused checks and one isolated negative demonstration, full Node suite once. Browser evidence may remain UNRUN if host-probe says unavailable: lead will run real GPU. No commits, pushes, extra agents or geometry changes. Report under500words.
